items.name: $3.6bn investment-grade GPU financing tied to Microsoft contract
items.claim: IREN secured $3.6bn of investment grade GPU financing for its Microsoft contract at a 6.0% rate, together with prepayments funding 96% of the associated GPU capex.
items.source_excerpt: $3.6bn investment grade GPU financing for Microsoft contract at 6.0%5  Together with prepayments, funds 96% of associated GPU capex

notes: FY26 results 8-K (EX-99.1) discloses a new frontier-AI-lab contract and Microsoft-tied GPU financing by name. IREN also carries a structured RPO fact ($5.1bn, period_end 2026-06-30) in data/market/IREN.json#fundamentals.remaining_performance_obligations, but that field is a nested object and tools/check_pipeline.py's xbrl matcher requires a bare scalar, so it cannot be cited as a source_kind: xbrl item under the current gate shape (see tasks/backlog.md, bucket xbrl-nested-field-mismatch, filed this run); omitted rather than written uncitable. A separate IREN IR page (iren.gcs-web.com, a $2.8bn new-customer-contracts release) and a GlobeNewswire mirror were queued but returned HTTP 403 / fetch failure, so neither is cited.
